extracted.intended_audience: NeurIPS attendees and the ML research community
extracted.subtask_short: NeurIPS 2024 Test of Time Award rationales
extracted.subtask_description: Short announcement of the two NeurIPS 2024 Test of Time Paper Awards (Generative Adversarial Nets; Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks), with brief rationales describing why each paper merits recognition ten years later: citation count, foundational nature, breadth of downstream impact, and architectural influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustained, decade-long influence on the field
rubrics_metrics.description: This award is intended to recognize papers published 10 years ago at NeurIPS 2014 that have significantly shaped the research field since then, standing the test of time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defining criterion of the Test of Time Award; an exception was made to award two papers this year given the 'undeniable influence of these two papers on the entire field.'

rubrics_metrics.name: High citation count as proxy for impact
rubrics_metrics.description: The Generative Adversarial Nets paper has been cited more than 85,000 times as of this blog post. ... Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks has been cited more than 27,000 times as of this blog post.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citation counts are explicitly given as evidence of impact in the award rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foundational role in a major sub-area
rubrics_metrics.description: It is one of the foundational pieces for generative modeling and has inspired numerous research advances in the past 10 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale for GAN paper: 'foundational' status in generative modeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broad downstream applicability beyond original domain
rubrics_metrics.description: Besides research, it has also enabled generative modeling to make an impact in a diverse range of applications, considering vision data and other domains.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale for GAN paper: not just academic but also broad application impact across data modalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laying the architectural cornerstone for later breakthroughs
rubrics_metrics.description: It is the cornerstone work that set the encoder-decoder architecture, inspiring later attention-based improvements leading to today's foundation model research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale for the Seq2Seq paper: foundational architectural contribution (encoder-decoder) that enabled subsequent breakthroughs (attention, foundation models).

rubrics_metrics.name: Enabling a paradigm shift in AI
rubrics_metrics.description: With the current fast advances of large language models and foundation models in general, making a paradigm shift in AI and applications, the field has benefited from the foundation laid by this work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale for Seq2Seq paper: the work is credited as part of the lineage that enabled today's paradigm shift in AI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Undeniable / consensus influence
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no doubt regarding the significance of these two works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strong consensus on impact was sufficient justification for the rare exception of awarding two Test of Time papers in the same year.
